name: What are common types of bathroom lighting fixtures?

mainEntity.name: What are common types of bathroom lighting fixtures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common bathroom lighting fixtures include vanity lights for task illumination around mirrors, recessed lights for general ambient lighting, and shower lights for wet areas. Accent lighting, such as toe-kick or niche lighting, can also be added for aesthetic purposes. The best choice depends on the bathroom's size, design, and specific lighting needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common types include vanity lights, recessed lights, and shower lights, each serving different functions like task, ambient, or accent lighting.
